messages:
sam: FYI alert — after the firmware fleet push in ap-northeast-2 a subset of GPU nodes dropped from the pool. Seeing ~18% evictions and some nodes showing SecureBoot flipping to ON during OOB reboot.
leo: Do we have logs? staging saw the same canary?
ops-bot: metric: provisioner.evictions.ap-northeast-2 +18% over 10m; affected_nodes=21; alert: oob-bmc-watchdog-cycles
maria: If it's the watchdog toggling UEFI attr we can reflash BMC to previous image via OOB. Command: 
```
ipmitool -H $BMC -U admin -P $PWD raw 0x30 0x45 0x01
fwupdmgr install /tmp/bmc-rollback-1.2.3.bin
```
sam: attaching the small iLO log snippet — shows SecureBoot value flip right after BMC watchdog reset:
```
[2026-03-18T09:12:15Z] BMC watchdog triggered reset
[2026-03-18T09:12:16Z] PCI: NIC re-enumeration
[2026-03-18T09:12:17Z] UEFI: SecureBoot -> 1
[2026-03-18T09:12:21Z] Provisioner: PXE not found, fallback failed
```
alex: We should DR with us-west1 dedicated pool to keep serving. Turn up +50 GPUs on dedicated -> cost estimate ~$3k/day. Worth it for SLAs?
leo: Can we hotpatch the provisioner to accept signed-image fallback? Small change: treat UEFI attr mismatch as soft-fail and try signed image.
maria: Compliance note: changing fallback behavior affects prod security posture. ok for non-prod. For prod we need approval from Sec.
sam: Temporary mitigation: deploy provisioner patch to ap-northeast-2 non-prod first. Patch diff:
```
- if (!uefi_match) fail;
+ if (!uefi_match) try_signed_fallback = true;
```
deploy-bot: canary deploy 2026-03-18_15:30 started to ap-northeast-2-nonprod — id d3f9c
maria: I'll coordinate OOB rollback on the 21 affected nodes at 20:00 JST — volunteers? @leo @sam
leo: I can take the first half (10 nodes).
alex: I'll open a temporary reserved capacity in us-west1, ETA 30m.
sam: action items: (1) leo run OOB reflashes 10 nodes (2) maria complete rest + verify secureboot bit (3) alex reserve capacity and toggle traffic routing (4) deploy patch to nonprod canary (5) Sec review for prod fallback. ETA EOD JST.
maria: noted. starting runbook now — link: https://runbooks.internal/oob-bmc-rollback :white_check_mark:
sam: thanks everyone — will post followups here. :thumbsup:
